require: Two normal-entry left downs only: the guarded title and card have consuming receipts; no further down, page fallback, save preload or capture.

Before and after hover, the same unique scene context and load have profile Eyecatch08Observation and a live eyecatch owner. Flow GAME_WAIT and eye WAIT each have no pending handler and wait for the current completed frame, with focus on, no pause, messages or movie.

Hover is move only. The enabled mouse mask and first candidate belong to the eye owner's low button; the second belongs to its flow ancestor's low button. Rebind IDs from the run. For a state-route acceptance, recheck the candidates and live owners together after a complete frame at the new pointer position. The historical frame probe reports hover candidates between its two snapshots, not a same-frame arm.
eyecatch_route_stop.on_match: Stop at the eye WAIT without a down; this proves neither eye exit nor a body page.
eyecatch_route_stop.on_unknown: Withhold input and retain logs; do not retry or treat active/c01_01 or the prefetched g0/144 as a checkpoint.

state_route_contract.when: After a normal pointer move to (640,360) and a completed frame. Require the guard to return a poll.
state_route_contract.one_click: Send one MouseButton(0) down for the next frame, with one matching release. Poll each completed frame, beginning with the frame that routed the down.
state_route_contract.stop: Success requires observed EXIT, removal of the eye and its low button, and cleared held input and capture. Stop at this boundary. A missing next-frame receipt, other receiver or unexpected state stops the route without a retry.
